description.zh: 是否激活；取值0或1，取值说明 0：不激活，1激活，默认激活
description.en: Specifies whether to activate the agent. Valid values: `1` (active) and `0` (inactive). Default value: `1`.

description.zh: 座席所属区号
description.en: The agent's area code.

description.zh: 呼叫权限；取值说明 0：无限制，1：国内长途，2：国内本市，3：内部呼叫，默认无限制
description.en: The call permission for the agent. Valid values: `0` (Unlimited), `1` (Domestic Long Distance), `2` (Local City), and `3` (Internal Calls). Default value: `0`.

description.zh: 开始座席工号；正整数，取值3-10位数字
description.en: The starting agent ID. The ID must be a positive integer 3 to 10 digits long.

description.zh: 备注
description.en: A descriptive remark.

description.zh: 结束座席工号；正整数，取值3-10位数字，单次批量创建不能超过100个
description.en: The ending agent ID. The ID must be a positive integer 3 to 10 digits long. You can create up to 100 agents per request.

description.zh: 呼叫中心 id
description.en: The call center ID.

description.zh: 呼入是否录音；取值说明 0：不录用，1：录音，默认录音
description.en: Specifies whether to enable recording for inbound calls. Valid values: `1` (yes) and `0` (no). Default value: `1`.

description.zh: 是否开启ASR转写；取值说明：0：不开启，1：开启，默认不开启
description.en: Specifies whether to enable ASR transcription. Valid values: `1` (yes) and `0` (no). Default value: `0`.

description.zh: 是否允许外呼；取值说明 0：不允许，1：可以，默认允许
description.en: Specifies whether the agent can make outbound calls. Valid values: `1` (yes) and `0` (no). Default value: `1`.

description.zh: 是否开启座席质检；取值说明：0：不开启，1：开启，默认开启
description.en: Specifies whether to enable agent quality check. Valid values: `1` (yes) and `0` (no). Default value: `1`.

description.zh: 座席姓名；需进行UTF-8格式的URLEncode编码
description.en: The name of the agent. The value must be URL-encoded in UTF-8.

description.zh: 透传号码；可传入企业中继号码或设置好的客户侧外显号码，当obClidType值为2或3时必选
description.en: The pass-through number to use as the caller ID. This can be an enterprise trunk number or a configured caller ID. This parameter is required when `ObClidType` is set to `2` or `3`.

description.zh: 外显属性；取值：{"isMatchCapital":0,"areaCodeRule":1}；obClidType=4时，isMatchCapital表示是否匹配省会号码，1是 0否，areaCodeRule表示区号匹配规则，1座席区号 2客户号码区号
description.en: Dynamic caller ID properties in JSON format. Example: `{"isMatchCapital":0,"areaCodeRule":1}`. This parameter applies only when `ObClidType` is set to `4`. The JSON string contains the following properties: `isMatchCapital` specifies whether to match the phone number of a provincial capital (`1`: yes, `0`: no), and `areaCodeRule` specifies the area code matching rule (`1`: Match the agent's area code, `2`: Match the customer's area code).

description.zh: 外显规则；取值：1:默认 2:随机 3:按区号 4 动态外显 ，默认值为1
description.en: The rule for displaying the caller ID for outbound calls. Valid values: `1` (Default), `2` (Random), `3` (By Area Code), and `4` (Dynamic). Default value: `1`.

description.zh: 外呼是否录音；取值说明 0：不录音，1：录音，默认录音
description.en: Specifies whether to enable recording for outbound calls. Valid values: `1` (yes) and `0` (no). Default value: `1`.

description.zh: 座席权限；取值1或0，取值说明 1：班长席，0：普通座席，默认为0 普通座席
description.en: The role of the agent. Valid values: `1` (supervisor) and `0` (regular agent). Default value: `0`.

description.zh: 所选的技能id；可选择多个，多个之间使用英文标点逗号间隔.例如:"1,2,3"；传入skillIds时，需要同时传入skillLevels
description.en: The skill IDs to assign to the agent. To assign multiple skills, separate the IDs with commas (`,`). Example: `1,2,3`. If you specify this parameter, you must also specify `SkillLevels`.

description.zh: 所选的技能的等级；值越小技能越高，多个间用英文标点逗号间隔。(与技能id相对应) 例如:"5,1,1"表示技能id为1的等级是5; 技能id为2的等级是1; 技能id为3的等级是1.
description.en: The levels for the skills specified in `SkillIds`. A smaller value indicates a higher proficiency. The skill levels must correspond to the skill IDs. To specify multiple levels, separate them with commas (`,`). For example, if `SkillIds` is `1,2,3` and `SkillLevels` is `5,1,1`, skill `1` is assigned level `5`, while skills `2` and `3` are assigned level `1`.

description.zh: webrtc软电话返回地址；取值说明：0：企业默认 1：公网域名 2：专线域名 3：公网IP 4：专线IP
description.en: The type of address to return for the WebRTC softphone. Valid values: `0` (enterprise default), `1` (public domain name), `2` (leased line domain name), `3` (public IP), and `4` (leased line IP).

description.zh: 整理时间；单位秒数，默认10秒
description.en: The agent's wrap-up time, in seconds. Default value: `10`.
